label: Bible Study
prompt: Consider the _____: for they neither sow nor reap; which neither have storehouse nor barn; and God feedeth them: how much more are ye better than the fowls?
verse: Consider the ravens: for they neither sow nor reap; which neither have storehouse nor barn; and God feedeth them: how much more are ye better than the fowls?
note: Consider the ravens — no storehouse, no barn, and God still feeds them.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: The Spirit of God hath made me, and the _____ of the Almighty hath given me life.
verse: The Spirit of God hath made me, and the breath of the Almighty hath given me life.
note: Elihu reminds Job that the Spirit made him and the Almighty's breath gave him life — every breath is a gift.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And because he was of the same craft, he abode with them, and wrought: for by their occupation they were _____.
verse: And because he was of the same craft, he abode with them, and wrought: for by their occupation they were tentmakers.
note: Paul paid his own way: he stayed with Aquila and Priscilla because they shared his trade — tentmaking.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Having a _____ of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.
verse: Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.
note: A last-days portrait: the look of religion with the engine removed — 'from such turn away.'

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and _____ is as iniquity and idolatry. Because thou hast rejected the word of the LORD, he hath also rejected thee from being king.
verse: For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry. Because thou hast rejected the word of the LORD, he hath also rejected thee from being king.
note: Samuel to Saul: rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and 'stubbornness' as idolatry. Disobedience is never small.
